tools.name: namedrop_check
tools.description: Is yourname.base.eth available to register (or registered and renewable)? Free, read-only.

tools.name: namedrop_quote
tools.description: Create a 30-minute quote to register (to an owner address) or renew a Basename, priced in USDC on Base (live Basenames fee + gas + $1 service). Returns quote_id, exact usdc amount, pay_to and instructions. Nothing is charged by quoting.

tools.name: namedrop_submit_payment
tools.description: After sending EXACTLY the quoted USDC on Base to pay_to, submit the quote_id and your Base tx hash. NameDrop verifies the transfer on-chain and registers/renews the name (or refunds the USDC if the name was taken first).

tools.name: namedrop_order
tools.description: Status of a NameDrop order by id (paid, registered with tx, or refunded with tx).
